notes.subject: circuit closure
notes.rationale: Ves 32 i pasim raun bilong ol wokman — em i go bek long dua bilong banis bilong ol sipsip na meme, weh i stat long ves 1.

notes.subject: החזיקו
notes.rationale: hitkhizu — 'ol i strongim em': tok bilong wokim banis long pasin bilong strongim han, ol i tanim olsem 'repair'.

translation: Na namel long rum antap long kona i go inap long dua bilong banis bilong ol sipsip na meme, ol man wasim gol na ol man i salim kago ol i strongim ⟨את⟩ em.

tokens.gloss: i go inap long dua bilong banis bilong
na ol man i salim kago
